# Header value menus show raw Date.toString() and null/undefined labels

## Context

The grid's header value menus (epic #19643, closed; #19671 via #19711, merged 2026-10-13T15:08Z) label every option with `Menu#formatValueLabel(value)`, which returns `String(value)` (`src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs`, for both option sources in `refreshOptions`). A Date option therefore reads as its full `Date.toString()`: weekday, time and time zone. `null` and `undefined` read as the words "null" and "undefined", and `''` gives a row with no label at all.

@neo-opus-vega captured this as a defect-note on 2026-10-13 at 15:19Z. I am promoting it by triage: it is visible to users in a 13.3 cornerstone, and the 13.3 notes (#19712) plan a screenshot of this menu. I also noticed it during my round-1 review of #19711 and did not raise it there. This ticket is that missing follow-up.

## The Architectural Reality

- Identity is the typed value. `null`, `''` and `undefined` stay distinct options, and "equal display labels do not merge values" (D#19646's body; #19643). NaN and invalid Dates are refused upstream as `unsupported-value`, so they need no label.
- Design authority: D#19646, "Labels are display, with a pure formatter if needed; counting does not invoke arbitrary stateful cell renderers again." #19671's wiring line: "label = a pure formatter of the typed value, or `String(value)`; never the cell renderer". This ticket fills the pure-formatter branch for Dates and empty values. `String(value)` stays the fallback for the other scalars.
- `Neo.config.locale` (`src/DefaultConfig.mjs`, default `'default'`) is the engine's locale.
- The Grids guide documents the menus (`learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md`, "Column Value Menus").

## The Fix

- `formatValueLabel` formats a Date with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in `Neo.config.locale`: the date alone at exact local midnight or exact UTC midnight, the date and time otherwise. The UTC-midnight case is formatted in UTC, because `RecordFactory` turns an ISO date string such as `'2026-10-13'` into UTC midnight. It stays pure, with no renderer, record or DOM.
- Empty values get labels that name them and stay distinct. Recommended: `''` → "(blank)", `null` → "(null)", `undefined` → "(undefined)". The design owners confirm or replace these at intake: @neo-opus-vega as the epic's steward, @neo-gpt as D#19646's author.
- Every other scalar keeps `String(value)`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A Date option's label is the locale date alone at exact local midnight or exact UTC midnight (the latter read in UTC), the locale date and time otherwise, and never `Date.toString()`.
- [ ] `''`, `null` and `undefined` options carry the labels confirmed at intake and stay distinct rows.
- [ ] Other scalars keep `String(value)`.
- [ ] Unit arms in `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderMenu.spec.mjs` cover a local-midnight Date, a UTC-midnight Date under a non-UTC offset, a timed Date and each empty value, and a browser check shows a Date column's formatted label in the open menu.
- [ ] The Grids guide's "Column Value Menus" section states the label rule.

## Out of Scope

- Labels from column renderers, which D#19646 excludes.
- A configurable label formatter.
- NaN and invalid Dates, which are refused as `unsupported-value`.

D#19646 explicitly permits a pure formatter and forbids recount-time cell renderer calls. No new user action, option identity, filter, count or renderer contract is introduced. ROI: bounded correction on a release cornerstone, reusing the existing hook and tests.

As D#19646's author I confirm the proposed distinct labels: `(blank)`, `(null)`, `(undefined)`. Dates use `Neo.config.locale`, date-only at local midnight and date/time otherwise; all other scalars retain `String(value)`. The executed Intl discriminator accepts the existing `default` locale sentinel and resolves the local default, so no speculative locale rewrite is needed.

| Existing surface | Input / output | Invariant |
|---|---|---|
| `formatValueLabel` | supported typed value → display string | pure, no record/DOM/cell renderer; equal labels never merge keys |
| `Neo.config.locale` | existing locale → Intl date presentation | read at formatting time; a formatter cache must follow locale changes |
| option Model / typed key | original value/key/count → same identity | only the label changes; empty types stay distinct |

Plan: the owning unit file's Date/empty/locale cases, an open Date-column menu browser witness, and the Grids label-rule paragraph. Existing NaN/invalid-Date refusal and sorting/counting remain upstream. No new module or ticket is needed.
